# Hypothesis: Sparse MLP columns consistently stronger on the observed self-check motif than on matched reference arithmetic may nominate a selective causal intervention; this contrast alone is not causal evidence.
bad_npz = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0000_mlp.npz")
ref_npz = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0001_mlp.npz")
score_bad = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0000_scores.npz")
score_ref = np.load("results/astra_clean_20261103/pass_02/text_0001_scores.npz")
layer_rows = []
candidate_rows = []
all_arrays = {}
for layer in range(24):
    bfull = bad_npz[f"layer_{layer}"]
    gfull = ref_npz[f"layer_{layer}"]
    b = bfull[399:469]
    g = gfull[399:469]
    babs = np.abs(b).mean(0)
    gabs = np.abs(g).mean(0)
    pabs = np.abs(bfull[:399]).mean(0)
    delta = b.mean(0)-g.mean(0)
    pooled = np.sqrt(.5*(b.var(0)+g.var(0))+1e-8)
    effect = delta/pooled
    first = np.abs(b[:35]).mean(0)-np.abs(g[:35]).mean(0)
    second = np.abs(b[35:]).mean(0)-np.abs(g[35:]).mean(0)
    name = f"model.language_model.layers.{layer}.mlp.down_proj.weight"
    w = load_original(name)
    colnorm = torch.linalg.vector_norm(w,dim=0).numpy()
    score = np.maximum(babs-gabs,0)*colnorm
    ratio = babs/(gabs+1e-6)
    prefix_ratio = babs/(pabs+1e-6)
    eligible = (ratio>=1.5)&(prefix_ratio>=1.3)&(first>0)&(second>0)
    ranking = np.argsort(np.where(eligible,score,-1))[::-1]
    selected = [int(j) for j in ranking[:8] if eligible[j]]
    layer_rows.append({"layer":layer,"effect_l2":float(np.linalg.norm(delta)/(np.sqrt(.5*(b.var(0).sum()+g.var(0).sum()))+1e-8)),"prefix_relative_l2":float(np.linalg.norm(bfull[:399]-gfull[:399])/(np.linalg.norm(bfull[:399])+1e-8)),"eligible_neurons":int(eligible.sum()),"top8_contribution_score":float(score[selected].sum()),"top8_columns":selected})
    for j in selected:
        candidate_rows.append({"layer":layer,"column":j,"score":float(score[j]),"bad_mean_abs":float(babs[j]),"reference_mean_abs":float(gabs[j]),"bad_reference_ratio":float(ratio[j]),"bad_prefix_ratio":float(prefix_ratio[j]),"standardized_signed_effect":float(effect[j]),"first_half_abs_delta":float(first[j]),"second_half_abs_delta":float(second[j]),"weight_column_norm":float(colnorm[j])})
    all_arrays[f"layer_{layer}"] = np.stack([babs,gabs,pabs,delta,pooled,first,second,colnorm,score,eligible.astype(float)])
np.savez_compressed("results/astra_clean_20261103/tf_contrast_arrays.npz",**all_arrays)
candidate_rows.sort(key=lambda r:r["score"],reverse=True)
result = {"analysis_window":{"prefix_tokens":399,"continuation_tokens":70},"matched_logprob":{"observed_loop":float(score_bad["logprobs"][398:468].mean()),"reference":float(score_ref["logprobs"][398:468].mean())},"layer_effects":layer_rows,"top_candidates":candidate_rows[:24],"edits_applied":edited()}
